 crank case, but only with the compressor at rest, the oil level should never

text:
This document lists the Equipment Inspection I1, which must be performed
 every week as indicated by W1 in the title block.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified 
 maintenance staff carry the suitable safety ID category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Wear standard personal safety and healthy equipment as 
 helmet, safety shoes, rubber gloves, ... etc.
Tools and Equipment
Safety Helmet
Safety glasses
Check oil level in compressor
 crank case, but only with the compressor at rest, the oil level should never
 fall below the sight-glass
Check for any unusual noises or
 vibrations
Check for air leaks in piping and
 pipe connections
Read and record gauge pressures
 and compressor running time indicator
Clean compressor room floor
